name: devops-cicd
description: Use when writing, reviewing or debugging CI/CD pipelines for self-hosted infrastructure - GitHub Actions (workflows, reusable workflows, composite actions, matrix, concurrency, caching, environments with required reviewers, OIDC instead of stored secrets, pinning actions by SHA or lockfile, permissions least privilege, self-hosted runners), GitLab CI (rules, needs, includes and components, environments, resource_group, protected variables, runners and executors), pointers for Jenkins / Forgejo-Gitea Actions / Woodpecker, pipeline design (build once promote many, quality gates, speed), image builds in CI (BuildKit cache, multi-arch, provenance/SBOM/signing), deploy strategies and rollback, release automation and pipeline troubleshooting. Not for GitOps controllers, Helm or Kustomize (devops-gitops-packaging), Dockerfile and registry craft (devops-docker), secret stores (devops-secrets), language-specific CI gates (framework experts), repo commit/release flow (commit agent) or a supply-chain audit (fuse-security:security-expert).

findings.excerpt: gh workflow list; gh run list --limit 10                 # read-only state
